subjects.name: British Columbia Development Corporation
subjects.label: British Columbia Development Corporation
subjects.note: The Crown corporation the Province set up in 1973 to develop industrial land and lend to and invest in B.C. business: industrial parks around the province and the waterfront redevelopments of Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver and, through its subsidiary First Capital City Development Company (1977), Westminster Quay in New Westminster.
